ResultProvenance.description:
Versioned generation metadata for a calibration result.

Result provenance deliberately allows additional pipeline-specific fields.
The fields below are the stable minimum required to identify how a new
result was produced.  Legacy v0.1 files may contain an unstructured map;
those files remain readable through :func:`load_result`, but are not
production-admissible until explicitly migrated.
ResultProvenance.title: ResultProvenance

provenance.description: Versioned provenance for new results. Legacy v0.1 maps, including an empty or omitted map, are readable but are not production-admissible.

SolidStateCaptureWindow.description: Observed timing and operating conditions for one capture interval.
SolidStateCaptureWindow.title: SolidStateCaptureWindow

SolidStateIntrinsicCalibration.description: Origin and representation of the sensor's internal calibration.
SolidStateIntrinsicCalibration.title: SolidStateIntrinsicCalibration

SolidStateLidarCalibrationContext.description: Result-level solid-state context for one calibration run.
SolidStateLidarCalibrationContext.title: SolidStateLidarCalibrationContext

SolidStateLidarProfile.description: Static and acquisition-semantic metadata for one solid-state LiDAR.

point_time_field.description: source field carrying per-point capture-time offsets, when applicable
point_time_field.title: Point Time Field

SolidStateLidarProfile.title: SolidStateLidarProfile

SolidStateProvenance.description: Provenance for solid-state metadata and operating-condition claims.
SolidStateProvenance.title: SolidStateProvenance

SolidStateTemperatureCondition.description: Temperature attached to a calibration or capture interval.
SolidStateTemperatureCondition.title: SolidStateTemperatureCondition

solid_state.description: optional solid-state LiDAR acquisition, intrinsic-calibration, temperature, and timing context
